ui_bugs.issue: slug() helpers produced broken data-testids for any label with accented characters (e.g. rendered nav-activite-s, nav-taches->nav-ta-ches, nav-ma-fide-lite, nav-e-ve-nements; shortcut--ducation, shortcut-v-t-rinaire, shortcut-r-union, shortcut-activit-s, shortcut-ma-fid-lit-; search-filter-activite-s / e-ve-nements). Root cause: after normalize('NFD') the combining marks (U+0300–U+036F) were not stripped and were then converted to dashes by the [^a-z]+ regex; DashboardShortcuts didn’t even NFD-normalize. Fixed by stripping combining marks and switching regex to [^a-z0-9]+ then trimming leading/trailing dashes. Verified all expected testids now match the review spec: nav-activites, nav-taches, nav-ma-fidelite, nav-mes-taches, nav-mon-chien, nav-participations, shortcut-education/-sport/-photo/-veterinaire/-collective/-visio/-reunion, search-filter-activites/-evenements/-membres/-projets/-chiens/-professionnels/-stocks/-documents/-guides.

rca of the issue: Broken data-testids for French/accented labels stemmed from slug() using normalize('NFD') + /[^a-z]+/g without first stripping combining marks (U+0300–U+036F). DashboardShortcuts.Tile omitted NFD entirely so accented base letters themselves were replaced by '-'. Fix: uniform slug that (1) toLowerCase, (2) normalize NFD, (3) replace /[\u0300-\u036f]/g with '', (4) replace /[^a-z0-9]+/g with '-', (5) trim leading/trailing '-'. Applied in 3 places; retested end-to-end for all 3 roles.
